## User Stories

### Create Slow Steps Section Container
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to see a container component for slow steps so that I have a dedicated area to display performance data
- **Priority:** P0
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Component renders in the test results view
  - [ ] Component handles loading state
  - [ ] Component integrates with TestStatsService
  - [ ] Component manages sorting state
  - [ ] Component passes data to child components

### Implement Slow Steps List View
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to see a list of slow test steps so that I can review performance bottlenecks
- **Priority:** P0
- **Story Points:** 5
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] List displays step description
  - [ ] List shows duration for each step
  - [ ] List displays timestamp
  - [ ] Steps are sortable by duration
  - [ ] Proper data formatting for duration and timestamp

### Create Individual Step Item Component
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to see detailed information for each slow step so that I can understand specific performance issues
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Displays step description
  - [ ] Shows formatted duration
  - [ ] Displays formatted timestamp
  - [ ] Implements consistent styling
  - [ ] Handles long descriptions appropriately

### Implement Empty State Display
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to see an appropriate message when no slow steps exist so that I understand the current state
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 1
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Shows empty state message when no data exists
  - [ ] Implements consistent styling with other empty states
  - [ ] Displays appropriate icon or illustration
  - [ ] Handles transition between empty and populated states

### Implement Duration-Based Sorting
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to sort slow steps by duration so that I can focus on the most critical performance issues
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Implements ascending and descending sort
  - [ ] Updates sort indicator in UI
  - [ ] Maintains sort state during component lifecycle
  - [ ] Handles sort state in URL parameters
  - [ ] Performs sorting efficiently


## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance: API response times < 200ms
- Security: Follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines
- Scalability: Support horizontal scaling
